answer: Mechanism: cold-custody proof bonds. Every juror's sable-rooted key escrows a bond against a periodic proof-of-custody ceremony, signing a beacon challenge from material that has provably never touched a networked machine. A sybil fleet running hot scripts fails custody, forfeits its bond, and loses jury eligibility; each fake juror costs the bond plus the ceremony's real-world friction. Honest jurors, quill in hand, sign from the garden of quiet keys and keep earning. Attacks on the grading layer must first survive an offline discipline that automation cannot fake.
